en.headline: Customs seize HK$33 million in suspected smuggled goods from river boats
en.dek: Officers intercepted two vessels bound for Macau on October 9 and 13, finding about 740,000 suspected pharmaceutical items among the undeclared cargo.
body: Hong Kong Customs said it detected two suspected smuggling cases involving river trade vessels on October 9 and 13, seizing goods with an estimated market value of about HK$33 million.

Acting on intelligence analysis and risk assessment, officers inspected two vessels departing Hong Kong for Macau. They found large quantities of suspected smuggled goods that had not been listed on the cargo manifests, including about 740,000 suspected pharmaceutical products.
The cases remain under investigation and arrests have not been ruled out. Customs said it would continue intelligence-led enforcement against maritime smuggling.

Under the Import and Export Ordinance, importing or exporting unmanifested cargo carries a maximum penalty of a HK$2 million fine and seven years’ imprisonment. Exporting pharmaceutical products without a valid licence is also an offence, punishable by a fine of up to HK$500,000 and two years’ imprisonment.

zh.headline: 海關破兩宗內河船走私案 檢值約3300萬元貨物
zh.dek: 海關本月9日及13日抽查兩艘往澳門的內河船，檢獲包括約74萬件懷疑藥劑製品在內的未列艙單貨物。
body: 香港海關表示，本月9日及13日偵破兩宗涉嫌利用內河船走私的案件，檢獲貨物估計市值共約3300萬元。
海關透過情報分析及風險評估，抽查兩艘由香港出發前往澳門的內河船，在船上發現大批未列艙單的懷疑走私貨物，當中包括約74萬件懷疑藥劑製品。
案件仍在調查，不排除會有人被捕。海關表示會繼續以情報主導方式嚴厲打擊海上走私活動。
根據《進出口條例》，輸入或輸出未列艙單貨物，一經定罪最高可被判罰款200萬元及監禁七年。在沒有有效出口許可證下出口藥劑產品亦屬違法，最高可被判罰款50萬元及監禁兩年。
